tool_definition.name: fs_list
tool_definition.description: List one directory level of the agent workspace: directories as "name/", files as "name<TAB>size". Omit path (or pass ".") for its root. A long listing stops at the result limit and says the offset to continue from.

offset.description: number of entries to skip, to read on from where a listing that stopped at the result limit says to continue (default 0)

path.description: workspace-relative directory to list; empty or "." is the root

tool_definition.name: fs_read
tool_definition.description: Read a file from the agent workspace. Returns the file text, one page at a time: a page that is not the whole file ends with the bytes it holds and the offset to continue from.

maxBytes.description: cap on returned bytes; the server limit still applies

offset.description: byte offset to start reading from (default 0)

path.description: workspace-relative slash path of the file

tool_definition.name: write_report
tool_definition.description: Write a report file under the run's output folder (reports/). This is the only file channel that survives the run; set append to extend an existing report. Set deliverable to true, with a title, on the file the person asked this run for: the run's results are listed by the files marked.

append.description: append to the report instead of replacing it

deliverable.description: true when this file is what the person asked this run for, so that it is listed first among the run's results; leave it out for a working note, a draft or data you only used along the way

path.description: report path relative to the reports/ output folder

title.description: with deliverable: a short name for the file, one line of plain text of at most 120 characters (default: the file's name)

function.name: write_report
function.arguments:
{"path": "hello.md", "content": "Files seen: SKILL.md

", "deliverable": true, "title": "Hello report"}
